meta.move: Strong path: owns the missed call, then evidence in order, then the rewrite
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have until 4:40, Hale. You asked for this meeting, so start with who decided on the zero, and when.
Ms. Kalinowski, thank you for coming in. Before anything else: I entered that zero before I called you, and that was wrong. I'm sorry.
Okay. Now tell me what you're basing it on.

Here's what I can show you. The document's version history: created at 11:31 PM the night before it was due, title only. At 11:52, 612 words arrive in one edit. At 11:58, another 794. No drafts before that.
Turn the screen toward me. People draft somewhere else and paste it in. And none of that was put to Owen before you entered a zero, was it?
Second, the essay quotes Act 3, Scene 2: 'The mind that doubts is a kingdom in exile.' That line is not in Hamlet. Here's the scene; you can search it yourself.
Seventeen-year-olds misquote Shakespeare all the time. Give me the scene, I'll find it myself.

Our procedure allows a supervised rewrite for a first concern. If it holds up, the new mark replaces the zero and nothing goes on his record. We could do it in my room, Thursday at 8:15, with the vice-principal supervising.
That's 4.4, and I want it in writing tonight, with the words nothing goes on his record. Before I agree to anything, who else has seen this, besides your vice-principal?

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

You offered a supervised rewrite of Owen's essay in your room on Thursday at 8:15, supervised by the vice-principal, with the new mark replacing the zero and nothing placed on his record. I still want that commitment in writing, including the words nothing goes on his record, and a full account of everyone who has seen this matter. I expect this in writing tonight.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: fallback position, with her demand that nothing go on Owen's record met by your offer of a supervised rewrite under procedure 4.4; she still wants it in writing tonight and wants to know who else has seen it, and she had not yet agreed to the rewrite, though you were very close to the fair outcome of a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record.
What moved her: you showed a quoted line that does not appear in the play and invited her to search the scene herself, which gave her something tied to the essay that she could check on her own.
What cost ground: nothing cost you ground, but you left her point about drafting elsewhere and pasting in unanswered and moved on, so the version history never fully stood.
What she never said: in October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your version history placed the essay's writing just before midnight the night before it was due, very close to the kind of night she has refused to think about; it proves nothing about the essay, but it is why she went straight to procedure when you showed it.
Try next time: when she said people draft elsewhere and paste it in, answer that before moving on, for example by offering to compare the essay with Owen's other writing samples, which the school's own procedure 4.3 asks for.
